Idle & Session Timing

When an untouched kiosk warns the guest, and how long before it resets to the welcome screen.

Idle warning after (seconds)

5–3600 seconds of no touch before the warning appears.

Idle reset countdown (seconds)

3–120 seconds the warning counts down before the session resets.

Choose backgrounds, preview the welcome screen and edit its message in Kiosk Welcome Screen.

Customer Screen Wording by Language

Edit welcome, menu, cart, checkout, payment, confirmation and help labels. Empty values use the default wording. Values containing placeholders should retain those placeholders.
